title: An Unusual Ichikara
author: blackjackfitz
rules:
An Unusual Ichikara

Play on Sudokupad

Rules:

• Fill each blank cell with a digit from 1-9 such that every digit 'n' appears exactly (10-n) times without repeating in any row or column.

• Divide the grid into regions. A region contains the numbers from 1 to 'n' once each, where 'n' is the largest number in the region.

• Region borders divide the blue lines into segments that each have the same sum. Different lines may have different sums.

• Digits separated by a white dot are consecutive and black dots separate cells where one digit is double the other.

I hope you enjoy it!
solutionCode: Column 1 from top to bottom, ignoring the blank space (8 numbers).
